Wrist Wrap.name: Wrist Wrap
Wrist Wrap.description: The user pins a subdued or cornered target's arms and binds the wrists behind their back with capture tape, cuffs, zip ties or cloth in a single motion. The target cannot use their hands or arms, including any Quirk aimed or emitted through the palms, until someone cuts them free or they break the binding with a feat of strength or Quirk power. Stamina: brief.
